text: The dashboard says what a project's explicit components earned for its code, at @gitdek's request (#780): proved, when a component's proof qualifies; tested in every state, when every passing conformance check reached every state its model has; tested, otherwise; and unchecked only when none of those holds. It said "component evidence" and "code unchecked" for ask3d's statue generation, whose code was tested in every state.
